title: SM-ACC-005A2: Arabic mobile-first nonfiscal service draft workspace
authority: User 2026-10-30 requested continued delivery of Smart Merchant V6; implementation of approved issue #33 after invoice-draft backend PR #32 qualified and merged.
scope: Add a real Arabic RTL service-draft preparation page, exact integer-money preview, role-gated nav and owner home link, saved drafts list and permission-negative E2E. No tax issuance.
out_of_scope: Issuing legally fiscal documents, tax calculations, AR, payment, POS integration, editable drafts, data export, production deployment.
task: Create a mobile-first web workflow against existing nonfiscal service-draft API. Preserve client request ID/payload on ambiguous outcomes, never invent numbers, scope access to real org global permissions. Add unit & real-browser E2E and separate UX acceptance.
validation: Exact-head Foundation/Accounting Web/Governance CI, unit money math, real Chromium+FastAPI+PostgreSQL rendered form, role/tenant negative; no production data.
stop_conditions: Mislabeling draft as tax invoice, code/CI failure, unauthorized access, cache leak, float money arithmetic, replay duplicate, undefined source data.
success_criteria: A permitted owner can save and inspect a service draft via real UI/BFF; exact pre-tax totals match backend; read-only visible to accountant; cashier/foreign organization denied; responsive RTL; all CI pass.
